scope: Independent offline terminal artifact, raw-provider, exact-request, native full-cohort and pair-side identity audit. No network requests, waveform decoding, correlation or selection changes.
checks: Both recorded child stages are terminal completed with returncode zero; every stage artifact and final input/output hash matches.
Every raw reply matches its byte count and request/response/native provenance; all POST bodies retain exact original NSLC/time selections and native epoch/resource/hash attachments.
All returned JSON datasource pointers, channels, rates, quality flags and spans match parsed records; independent exact rational time arithmetic rederives every covering-span index.
All 14,262 original pick rows and all 44,718 original catalog difference rows retain every original column value and order; no row is removed for a missing reported span.
Both sides of every catalog pair match their original event/origin/pick/arrival IDs, common SEED/FDSN channel, distinct native metadata epochs and raw availability responses.
Joined status/count fields agree with the independently rederived coverage and the final summary.
limitations: Provider-reported coverage is not decoded waveform identity, actual sample-grid alignment, continuity or overlap validation.
No covering span reported does not establish historical waveform absence, study exclusion or permission to discard the identified record.
The 464 reported windows and 1,232 pairs with both reported spans are an access inventory, not accepted correlation measurements or solver observations.
The controller has no process-group interruption cleanup; this run completed normally, but future interrupted retrievals require child-state inspection before recovery.
Instrument response/calibration is not a prerequisite under the user instruction; missing response and historical CMW1 routing metadata remain explicit.
